Marion Craig began her CrossFit journey in 2013, motivated by a desire to counteract the effects of aging. The demanding nature of CrossFit, including its intense workouts and challenging movements, inspired her to continually strive for athletic improvement. Marion particularly enjoys endurance WODs, as they allow her to focus and test the limits of her perseverance. Marion’s athletic background is extensive and impressive. She has represented Canada internationally in triathlons and cross-country skiing and competed for Team Canada
